environment.description: Go stream processor deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no application-layer filtering. Kafka topic 'user-events' accepts messages from any authenticated producer. The HTTP endpoint /api/v1/events/submit is exposed on port 8080 via the NLB's TCP listener. No template sandboxing or input validation is applied. Container runs as root with full filesystem access.

config.container_runtime: ECS Fargate, task role with S3/SQS access
config.network: VPC with public subnet, NLB internet-facing
